current_owl:
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix : <http://www.example.org/ontology#> .

<http://www.example.org/ontology/hospital_story> a owl:Ontology .

#################################################################
#    Classes
#################################################################
:Person a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Person" ; rdfs:comment "A human individual in the hospital context." .
:Doctor a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Doctor" ; rdfs:comment "A medical doctor working in the hospital." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Person .
:Nurse a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Nurse" ; rdfs:comment "A certified nurse working in the hospital." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Person .
:NursingAssistant a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Nursing Assistant" ; rdfs:comment "A nursing assistant working in the hospital." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Person .
:Employee a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Employee" ; rdfs:comment "An employee working in the hospital." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Person .
:Degree a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Degree" ; rdfs:comment "A medical degree or certification." .
:Hospital a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Hospital" ; rdfs:comment "A hospital where people are employed and seminars are held." .
:City a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "City" ; rdfs:comment "A city where a hospital is located." .
:Country a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Country" ; rdfs:comment "A country in which a city is located." .
:Union a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Union" ; rdfs:comment "A union organizing hospital staff." .
:UnionMembership a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Union Membership" ; rdfs:comment "A membership of a person in a union at a given time (pivot class)." .
:UnionRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Union Role" ; rdfs:comment "A role held by a person within a union group." .
:Employment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Employment" ; rdfs:comment "An event of employment of a person at a hospital (pivot class)." .
:Evaluation a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Evaluation" ; rdfs:comment "A written evaluation of an employee by a doctor (pivot class)." .
:Article a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Article" ; rdfs:comment "A research article read or presented by staff." .
:ArticleCollection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Article Collection" ; rdfs:comment "A collection of research articles, as a book or CD." .
:Book a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Book" ; rdfs:comment "A physical book containing articles." ; rdfs:subClassOf :ArticleCollection .
:CD a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "CD" ; rdfs:comment "An electronic CD containing articles." ; rdfs:subClassOf :ArticleCollection .
:Seminar a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Seminar" ; rdfs:comment "A seminar held at a hospital for presenting articles." .
:SeminarPresentation a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Seminar Presentation" ; rdfs:comment "A presentation of an article at a seminar (pivot class)." .

# Disjointness
:Doctor owl:disjointWith :Nurse, :NursingAssistant .
:Nurse owl:disjointWith :NursingAssistant .

#################################################################
#    Object Properties
#################################################################
:hasDegree a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has degree" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a person to a degree they have received." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range :Degree .
:studiedForDegree a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "studied for degree" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a person to a degree they studied for." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range :Degree .
:employmentAt a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "employment at" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an employment event to a hospital." ; rdfs:domain :Employment ; rdfs:range :Hospital .
:locatedInCity a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "located in city" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a hospital to the city it is located in." ; rdfs:domain :Hospital ; rdfs:range :City .
:locatedInCountry a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "located in country" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a city to the country it is located in." ; rdfs:domain :City ; rdfs:range :Country .
:hasUnionMembership a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has union membership" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a person to a union membership." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range :UnionMembership .
:memberOfUnion a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "member of union" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a union membership to a union." ; rdfs:domain :UnionMembership ; rdfs:range :Union .
:hasUnionRole a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has union role" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a union membership to a union role." ; rdfs:domain :UnionMembership ; rdfs:range :UnionRole .
:evaluatedBy a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "evaluated by" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an evaluation to the doctor who made it." ; rdfs:domain :Evaluation ; rdfs:range :Doctor .
:evaluates a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "evaluates" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a doctor to the evaluations they have made." ; rdfs:domain :Doctor ; rdfs:range :Evaluation .
:evaluatedEmployee a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "evaluated employee" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an evaluation to the employee being evaluated." ; rdfs:domain :Evaluation ; rdfs:range :Employee .
:readsArticle a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "reads article" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a person to an article they have read." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range :Article .
:containedInCollection a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "contained in collection" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an article to the collection it is contained in." ; rdfs:domain :Article ; rdfs:range :ArticleCollection .
:hasArticle a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has article" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an article collection to its articles." ; rdfs:domain :ArticleCollection ; rdfs:range :Article .
:publishedAsBook a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "published as book" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an article collection to a book." ; rdfs:domain :ArticleCollection ; rdfs:range :Book .
:publishedAsCD a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "published as CD" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an article collection to a CD." ; rdfs:domain :ArticleCollection ; rdfs:range :CD .
:seminarLocation a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "seminar location" ; rdfs:comment "Location (hospital) of the seminar." ; rdfs:domain :Seminar ; rdfs:range :Hospital .
:hasSeminarPresentation a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has seminar presentation" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a seminar to its presentations." ; rdfs:domain :Seminar ; rdfs:range :SeminarPresentation .
:presentedArticle a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "presented article" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a seminar presentation to the article presented." ; rdfs:domain :SeminarPresentation ; rdfs:range :Article .
:presentedAtSeminar a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "presented at seminar" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a seminar presentation to the seminar." ; rdfs:domain :SeminarPresentation ; rdfs:range :Seminar .

#################################################################
#    Data Properties
#################################################################
:studyPeriod a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "study period" ; rdfs:comment "The period during which a person studied for a degree." ; rdfs:domain :Employment ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:employmentStart a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "employment start" ; rdfs:comment "The start date of an employment." ; rdfs:domain :Employment ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
:unionMembershipStart a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "union membership start" ; rdfs:comment "The start date of a union membership." ; rdfs:domain :UnionMembership ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
:evaluationStatement a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "evaluation statement" ; rdfs:comment "The evaluation statement text." ; rdfs:domain :Evaluation ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:publicationDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "publication date" ; rdfs:comment "Publication date of a book or CD." ; rdfs:domain :Book, :CD ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
:numberOfPages a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "number of pages" ; rdfs:comment "Number of pages in a book." ; rdfs:domain :Book ; rdfs:range xsd:integer .
:seminarDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "seminar date" ; rdfs:comment "The date a seminar took place." ; rdfs:domain :Seminar ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .

#################################################################
#    Functional Properties
#################################################################
:hasDegree rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasUnionRole rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:evaluatedEmployee rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:publishedAsBook rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:publishedAsCD rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:seminarLocation rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:presentedArticle rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:presentedAtSeminar rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:employmentStart rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:unionMembershipStart rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:publicationDate rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:numberOfPages rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:seminarDate rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .

#################################################################
#    Restrictions & GCAs
#################################################################
:Seminar owl:equivalentClass [ rdf:type owl:Class ; owl:onProperty :hasSeminarPresentation ; owl:someValuesFrom :SeminarPresentation ] .
:SeminarPresentation owl:equivalentClass [ rdf:type owl:Class ; owl:onProperty :presentedArticle ; owl:allValuesFrom :Article ] .
